name: cancel_appointment

messages.content: Thanks for your patience, I'm still working on that.

description: Cancel one of the caller's own upcoming appointments. Only after the caller has asked to cancel, you have read the appointment back (day, time, doctor), and they confirmed. The server re-verifies identity by phone number plus date of birth and only allows the caller's own appointments.

appointment_id.description: The appointment_id of the appointment to cancel, copied exactly from the VERIFIED result's upcoming_appointments.

date_of_birth.description: The date of birth the caller stated to verify their identity, as MM/DD/YYYY.

phone_number.description: Only if there is no caller ID or the appointment is under a different number: the phone number on the patient's record. Omit to use the caller ID.
